verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can export content at any time in Markdown, an open format, or the native Any-Block format, and can export all your channels. The privacy docs also say you can leave anytime and take your data with you. Community complaints about opaque on-disk storage and lack of native raw Markdown/CSV files concern internal storage, not the export feature, so they lower confidence rather than contradict the claim. missing for 10: evidence that Markdown export preserves databases, relations, Types and files for all data, any CSV or other structured open export format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export-and-leave workflow.
